title: Private device data leaves with you
summary: Clear private local data at session end and tighten browser and database security boundaries.
changes: Signing out, losing approved access or reaching an invalid session now removes the saved offline roster, cached account email and recently entered staff names from that device.
Authentication and database errors use safe messages, copied diagnostics omit the account email, and the pinned Supabase browser library now has a verified integrity hash.
A reviewable database migration removes unused anonymous public-schema privileges without relaxing RLS or changing authenticated permissions.
Roster calculations, staffing, allocations, Pager, Reliever, installed-PWA identity and the interface remain unchanged.
